title: Literal common-stage pullback objects and normalized comparisons
statement: For a scheme morphism f : X → Y with the stated residue-characteristic invertibility assumptions, retain the original common-stage pullback object (E, rationalDerivedPullback_E(f)(P)) at the literal input stage E. For every E ≤ L, retain the specified comparison from its scalar extension to the pullback of the extended input: compose the recorded transition identification, rational pullback scalar comparison, and inverse input transition identification. These are the existing definitions with identical signatures and bodies.

lean.statement:
def commonStagePullbackComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (P : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y)
    (L : Index l Ω) (h : P.stage ≤ L) :
    (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f P).toStage h ≅
      (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f).obj (P.toStage h)
